description: This file defines the Comment class within the Opencart admin controller event namespace. The class handles event-driven actions for adding, editing, and deleting comments, primarily by scheduling tasks related to comment processing.

classes.name: Comment
classes.description: Handles event hooks for comment related actions in the admin panel, scheduling tasks upon comment add, edit, or delete events.

methods.name: addComment
methods.description: Schedules a task to handle post-add comment processing, using the article ID.

methods.name: editComment
methods.description: Schedules a task to handle post-edit comment processing, using the article ID.

methods.name: deleteComment
methods.description: Schedules a task to handle post-delete comment processing, using the article ID.
